commit.message:
Derive exact mask populations and preserve the same packing across whole periods

Prove ordinary lower-block strictness from binary disjointness before calculating the exact four-block population, with no Pell lower-bound assumption. Transfer the same source, carries and F across congruent strides using actual rotation equality and a newly derived transport congruence.

Record root and independent isolated replays, twelve standard-only axiom audits, matching objects, overlap and noncongruent-rotation controls. Keep actual rank calibration, forced-stride selection and remaining positive Pell witnesses explicit.

+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentNativePacking2011
+
+/-!
+# Rephasing the same constructed words by a whole cyclic period
+
+Equal cell strides in ZMod N leave the marker, source, normalized digits,
+and carries unchanged. The new transport congruence is proved from the
+actual equal binary rotations. Its ordinary multiplier and quotient
+witness may change; no equality between those ordinary multipliers is used.
+-/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CurrentWordRephase2011
+
+open NativeCyclicConvolution NativeCyclicRotation NativeBooleanRotation
+  CurrentMasks2011 CurrentWordConstruction2011 CurrentWordClause2011
+  CurrentWordCopies2011 CurrentWordScalarWitness2011 WangTiles942Periodic
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+/-- A generic carry solution transfers across an actual equality of binary
+rotations. Its new scalar transport is derived, not supplied separately. -/
+theorem normalization_of_rotation_eq {n : ℕ} [NeZero n]
+    (c carry digits : ZMod n → ℕ) (W W' : ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts c W carry digits)
+    (hr : binaryRotation 47 W' c = binaryRotation 47 W c) :
+    CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts c W' carry digits := by
+  have hraw : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.raw c W' =
+      CurrentCarryConstruction2011.raw c W := by
+    funext i
+    simp only [CurrentCarryConstruction2011.raw,hr]
+  refine ⟨hf.carry_bound,hf.digit_bound,?_,?_,hf.word_bound,?_⟩
+  · intro i
+    rw [hraw]
+    exact hf.recurrence i
+  · intro i
+    rw [hraw]
+    exact hf.decomposition i
+  · have hnew := word_binaryRotation 47 W' c
+    have hold := word_binaryRotation 47 W c
+    rw [hr] at hnew
+    have hm := (hnew.symm.trans hold).add_left
+      (CurrentKernel2011.K*word radix c)
+    have he : (CurrentKernel2011.K+2^W')*word radix c ≡
+        (CurrentKernel2011.K+2^W)*word radix c [MOD radix^n-1] := by
+      simpa only [Nat.add_mul,CurrentMasks2011.radix] using hm
+    exact he.trans hf.transport
+
+variable {N : ℕ} [NeZero N]
+
+/-- Scaling equal cell positions gives equal physical field shifts. -/
+theorem physical_shift_eq (s t : ℕ) (hst : (s : ZMod N) = (t : ZMod N)) :
+    ((2011*s : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011)) = ((2011*t : ℕ) : ZMod (N*2011)) := by
+  have h := congrArg (base (N := N)) hst
+  simpa only [base_natCast,Nat.mul_comm] using h
+
+omit [NeZero N] in
+/-- Canonical marker equality gives equality of the complete source functions.
+No Boolean control or matching assumption is needed. -/
+theorem constructedWord_eq (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (s t : ℕ) (hst : (s : ZMod N) = (t : ZMod N)) :
+    constructedWord a dummy s = constructedWord a dummy t := by
+  unfold constructedWord
+  rw [hst]
+
+/-- The actual pointwise binary rotations agree, including all cell wraps. -/
+theorem rotation_eq (c : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ) (hc : ∀ i, c i ≤ 1)
+    (s t : ℕ) (hst : (s : ZMod N) = (t : ZMod N)) :
+    binaryRotation 47 (displacement s) c = binaryRotation 47 (displacement t) c := by
+  funext i
+  rw [rotation_zero_phase (by decide : 0 < 47) _ c hc (by simp [displacement]),
+    rotation_zero_phase (by decide : 0 < 47) _ c hc (by simp [displacement])]
+  simp only [displacement,Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ (by decide : 0 < 47)]
+  rw [physical_shift_eq s t hst]
+
+/-- The same source, carries, and digit function satisfy the new normalization. -/
+theorem normalization_rephase (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ j, dummy j ≤ 1) (s t : ℕ) (hst : (s : ZMod N) = (t : ZMod N))
+    (carry digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+      (constructedWord a dummy s) (displacement s) carry digits) :
+    CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+      (constructedWord a dummy t) (displacement t) carry digits := by
+  rw [← constructedWord_eq a dummy s t hst]
+  exact normalization_of_rotation_eq _ carry digits _ _ hf
+    (rotation_eq _ (constructed_boolean a dummy hd s) s t hst).symm
+
+/-- Matching uses only the residue of the temporal cell stride. -/
+theorem markedWord_rephase (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (s t : ℕ)
+    (hst : (s : ZMod N) = (t : ZMod N)) (ha : MarkedWord N (s : ℤ) a) :
+    MarkedWord N (t : ℤ) a := by
+  refine ⟨ha.start_at_zero,ha.horizontal,?_⟩
+  intro i
+  simpa only [Int.cast_natCast,← hst] using ha.temporal i
+
+/-- The complete scalar and mask packing transfers for the SAME carries and
+digits. Its positive quotient is recomputed for the new ordinary multiplier. -/
+theorem marked_packing_rephase (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ j, dummy j ≤ 1) (s t : ℕ) (hst : (s : ZMod N) = (t : ZMod N))
+    (ha : MarkedWord N (s : ℤ) a) (carry digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+      (constructedWord a dummy s) (displacement s) carry digits) :
+    CurrentNativePacking2011.Facts a dummy t carry digits := by
+  have hf' := normalization_rephase a dummy hd s t hst carry digits hf
+  have ha' := markedWord_rephase a s t hst ha
+  obtain ⟨hscalar,hlow⟩ := scalar_witness a dummy _ hd (shiftedStartMarker_boolean a _)
+    ha.start_at_zero t carry digits hf'
+  exact ⟨hf',hscalar,hlow,
+    CurrentWordHighMask2011.scalar_high_mask a dummy hd t ha' carry digits hf',
+    CurrentWordHighMask2011.all_mask_digits a dummy hd t ha' carry digits hf',
+    CurrentNativePacking2011.repunit_pos,CurrentNativePacking2011.repunit_balance⟩
+
+/-- Preserve the particular existing packing rather than choosing a new
+normalization. No rank congruence or rank-growth premise is inserted. -/
+theorem packing_rephase (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ j, dummy j ≤ 1) (s t : ℕ) (hst : (s : ZMod N) = (t : ZMod N))
+    (ha : MarkedWord N (s : ℤ) a) (carry digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentNativePacking2011.Facts a dummy s carry digits) :
+    CurrentNativePacking2011.Facts a dummy t carry digits :=
+  marked_packing_rephase a dummy hd s t hst ha carry digits hf.normalization
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.CurrentWordRephase2011

+import DiophantineConsistency.CurrentWordRephase2011
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.CurrentWordRephase2011Checks
+
+open CurrentWordRephase2011 CurrentWordConstruction2011 CurrentWordClause2011
+  CurrentWordCopies2011 CurrentWordScalarWitness2011 CurrentMasks2011
+  NativeCyclicRotation NativeBooleanRotation WangTiles942Periodic
+
+set_option Elab.async false
+set_option maxRecDepth 10000
+
+-- Seventeen periods at N=1 preserve even non-Boolean source controls.
+example (a : ZMod 1 → Fin 942) :
+    constructedWord a (fun _ => 7) 0 = constructedWord a (fun _ => 7) 17 :=
+  constructedWord_eq a _ 0 17 (Subsingleton.elim _ _)
+
+-- Two complete periods at N=3 preserve the exact physical shift.
+example : ((2011*1 : ℕ) : ZMod (3*2011)) = ((2011*7 : ℕ) : ZMod (3*2011)) :=
+  physical_shift_eq 1 7 (by decide : (1 : ZMod 3) = 7)
+
+example (a : ZMod 3 → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod 3 → ℕ) :
+    NativeCyclicConvolution.word radix (constructedWord a dummy 1) =
+      NativeCyclicConvolution.word radix (constructedWord a dummy 7) := by
+  rw [constructedWord_eq a dummy 1 7 (by decide)]
+
+-- Equal cyclic shifts do not imply equal ordinary temporal multipliers.
+example : (0 : ZMod 1) = 1 ∧ multiplier 0 ≠ multiplier 1 := by
+  refine ⟨Subsingleton.elim _ _,?_⟩
+  have hp : 1 < 2^(47*(2011*1)) := one_lt_pow₀ (by decide) (by decide)
+  change 2^(47*(2011*0)) ≠ 2^(47*(2011*1))
+  simp only [Nat.mul_zero,pow_zero]
+  omega
+
+-- A one-cell normalization transfers without pretending there is a
+-- one-cell marked tiling. The actual k and digits are retained verbatim.
+example (a : ZMod 1 → Fin 942) (k digits : ZMod (1*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+      (constructedWord a (fun _ => 1) 0) (displacement 0) k digits) :
+    CurrentCarryConstruction2011.Facts
+      (constructedWord a (fun _ => 1) 17) (displacement 17) k digits :=
+  normalization_rephase a _ (fun _ => by decide) 0 17 (Subsingleton.elim _ _) k digits hf
+
+-- The stride congruence matters. At two cells, a single origin bit moves
+-- away from physical0 under stride1 but not under stride0.
+private def originBit (i : ZMod (2*2011)) : ℕ := if i = 0 then 1 else 0
+private theorem originBit_boolean (i : ZMod (2*2011)) : originBit i ≤ 1 := by
+  unfold originBit
+  split_ifs <;> decide
+
+example : binaryRotation 47 (displacement 0) originBit 0 = 1 := by
+  rw [rotation_zero_phase (by decide : 0 < 47) _ originBit originBit_boolean
+    (by simp [displacement])]
+  decide
+example : binaryRotation 47 (displacement 1) originBit 0 = 0 := by
+  rw [rotation_zero_phase (by decide : 0 < 47) _ originBit originBit_boolean
+    (by simp [displacement])]
+  decide
+
+-- The complete new packing comes from the old particular normalization;
+-- a fresh choice of F, carries, source, or tiling is not permitted here.
+example {N : ℕ} [NeZero N] (a : ZMod N → Fin 942) (dummy : ZMod N → ℕ)
+    (hd : ∀ j, dummy j ≤ 1) (s t : ℕ) (hst : (s : ZMod N) = (t : ZMod N))
+    (ha : MarkedWord N (s : ℤ) a) (k digits : ZMod (N*2011) → ℕ)
+    (hf : CurrentNativePacking2011.Facts a dummy s k digits) :
+    CurrentNativePacking2011.Facts a dummy t k digits ∧
+      NativeCyclicConvolution.word radix (constructedWord a dummy s) =
+        NativeCyclicConvolution.word radix (constructedWord a dummy t) := by
+  refine ⟨packing_rephase a dummy hd s t hst ha k digits hf,?_⟩
+  rw [constructedWord_eq a dummy s t hst]
+
+#print axioms normalization_of_rotation_eq
+#print axioms physical_shift_eq
+#print axioms constructedWord_eq
+#print axioms rotation_eq
+#print axioms normalization_rephase
+#print axioms markedWord_rephase
+#print axioms marked_packing_rephase
+#print axioms packing_rephase
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.CurrentWordRephase2011Checks

+import DiophantineConsistency.NativeMaskPopulation
+
+/-! Exact converse population calculation from two successful native masks.
+All block bounds are proved before binary populations are split. -/
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.NativePackingPopulation
+
+open Jones1982
+set_option Elab.async false
+
+/-- Disjoint binary words below one window have an ordinary sum below it. -/
+theorem disjoint_add_lt {u A M : ℕ} (hA : A < 2^u) (hM : M < 2^u)
+    (hm : A &&& M = 0) : A+M < 2^u := by
+  have he := JM1984.add_eq_land_add_lor A M
+  rw [hm,zero_add] at he
+  rw [he]
+  exact Nat.or_lt_two_pow hA hM
+
+/-- The top block is unrestricted; all lower blocks are strict representatives. -/
+theorem four_block_exact {u A B C : ℕ} (D : ℕ)
+    (hA : A < 2^u) (hB : B < 2^u) (hC : C < 2^u) :
+    σ 2 (A+2^u*B+(2^u)^2*C+(2^u)^3*D) =
+      σ 2 A+σ 2 B+σ 2 C+σ 2 D := by
+  have he : A+2^u*B+(2^u)^2*C+(2^u)^3*D =
+      ((D*2^u+C)*2^u+B)*2^u+A := by ring
+  rw [he,lemma_2_5 hA,lemma_2_5 hB,lemma_2_5 hC]
+  omega
+
+/-- Successful masks give the exact population; no lower bound from a
+Pell source or already calibrated population is assumed. -/
+theorem mask_population {u A F M H : ℕ}
+    (hA : A < 2^u) (hF : F < 2^u) (hM : M < 2^u) (hH : H < 2^u)
+    (hmA : A &&& M = 0) (hmF : F &&& H = 0) :
+    σ 2 ((A+M)+2^u*(F+H)+(2^u)^2*(2^u-1-A)+
+      (2^u)^3*(2^u-1-F)) = 2*u+σ 2 M+σ 2 H := by
+  have hq : 0 < 2^u := Nat.two_pow_pos _
+  have hpacked := four_block_exact (2^u-1-F)
+    (disjoint_add_lt hA hM hmA) (disjoint_add_lt hF hH hmF)
+    (by omega : 2^u-1-A < 2^u)
+  have hAM := lemma_2_2 A M
+  have hFH := lemma_2_2 F H
+  rw [(τ_two_eq_zero_iff A M).mpr hmA,zero_add] at hAM
+  rw [(τ_two_eq_zero_iff F H).mpr hmF,zero_add] at hFH
+  have hCA := lemma_2_6 hA
+  have hCF := lemma_2_6 hF
+  omega
+
+theorem calibrated_population {u A F M H : ℕ}
+    (hA : A < 2^u) (hF : F < 2^u) (hM : M < 2^u) (hH : H < 2^u)
+    (hmA : A &&& M = 0) (hmF : F &&& H = 0)
+    (hpop : σ 2 M+σ 2 H = u+2) :
+    σ 2 ((A+M)+2^u*(F+H)+(2^u)^2*(2^u-1-A)+
+      (2^u)^3*(2^u-1-F)) = 3*u+2 := by
+  rw [mask_population hA hF hM hH hmA hmF]
+  omega
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.NativePackingPopulation

+import DiophantineConsistency.NativePackingPopulation
+
+namespace DiophantineConsistency.NativePackingPopulationChecks
+
+open Jones1982 NativePackingPopulation
+set_option Elab.async false
+
+-- A zero-width lower window is retained; the unrestricted top block may be large.
+example : σ 2 (0+2^0*0+(2^0)^2*0+(2^0)^3*37) = σ 2 37 := by
+  simpa only [σ_two_zero,zero_add] using
+    four_block_exact (u:=0) (A:=0) (B:=0) (C:=0) 37
+      (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
+
+-- Independent lower masks and complement blocks, with a nonzero overlap-free sum.
+example : σ 2 ((1+6)+8*(2+5)+8^2*(8-1-1)+8^3*(8-1-2)) = 10 := by
+  have h := mask_population (u:=3) (A:=1) (F:=2) (M:=6) (H:=5)
+    (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide) (by decide)
+  convert h using 1 <;> decide
+
+-- Carrying within one lower block invalidates the claimed population sum.
+example : σ 2 ((1+1)+8*(2+5)+8^2*(8-1-1)+8^3*(8-1-2)) ≠
+    2*3+σ 2 1+σ 2 5 := by decide
+
+-- Two strict representatives alone do not make their sum strict.
+example : (7:ℕ)<2^3 ∧ 7<2^3 ∧ ¬7+7<2^3 := by decide
+
+#print axioms disjoint_add_lt
+#print axioms four_block_exact
+#print axioms mask_population
+#print axioms calibrated_population
+
+end DiophantineConsistency.NativePackingPopulationChecks

+# Whole-period rephasing: author receipt
+
+This packet preserves the complete source function, carries, and normalized
+digits when the natural cell stride changes by a whole cyclic period. It
+derives the new scalar transport from equality of the actual binary rotations;
+it does not equate the two ordinary temporal multipliers. This is an author
+receipt, not an independent review.
+
+## Frozen files

+
+The author also authored the copy and padding packets and independently
+reviewed the native-packing composition. These roles do not constitute an
+independent review of this new packet. Existing compiled prerequisites were
+reused; this task did not rebuild or replace them.
+
+## Exact result and premises
+
+For `[NeZero N]`, natural strides `s,t`, and the explicit hypothesis
+`(s : ZMod N) = (t : ZMod N)`, `physical_shift_eq` proves equality of the
+physical shifts `2011*s` and `2011*t` in `ZMod (N*2011)` through the actual
+cell-base map. `constructedWord_eq` proves equality of the complete source
+functions, including the canonical shifted Start marker. That source identity
+does not require Boolean dummy controls or matching, and remains valid at
+`N=0`; normalization itself uses a nonzero cyclic length.
+
+For any Boolean source, `rotation_eq` uses the actual zero-fractional-phase
+rotation theorem to identify both binary rotations. The generic
+`normalization_of_rotation_eq` then retains the same carry and digit functions
+and every carry bound, digit bound, recurrence, decomposition, and word bound.
+Its transport proof combines both `word_binaryRotation` congruences and the old
+transport. Equality of ordinary factors `2^W` and `2^W'` is neither assumed nor
+concluded.
+
+`normalization_rephase` binds this argument to the actual constructed source
+with Boolean dummy controls. `markedWord_rephase` transports the same actual
+tile word using only the stride residue. Finally `marked_packing_rephase` and
+`packing_rephase` produce the complete `CurrentNativePacking2011.Facts` at the
+new stride for the SAME particular source, carries, and normalized digits.
+The actual low and high masks are re-established against those same words;
+the repunit and dimension identities remain unchanged.
+
+The new positive scalar quotient is recomputed by `scalar_witness` for
+`K + 2^(displacement t)`. The ordinary multiplier and quotient may differ from
+their old values. No rank congruence, rank growth, forced rank exponent, safe
+dummy mutation, native-source31 witness, or polynomial converse is asserted.
+The modular stride equality is an explicit input to this packet.
+
+## Fresh verification
+
+All new source and checks were read before execution; the final main was read
+again after its elaboration correction. Both files set `Elab.async false`.
+The direct sequential commands were:
+
+```sh
+lake env lean -M6000 -j1 Computability/DiophantineConsistency/Lean/DiophantineConsistency/CurrentWordRephase2011.lean -o .lake/build/lib/lean/DiophantineConsistency/CurrentWordRephase2011.olean
+lake env lean -M6000 -j1 Computability/DiophantineConsistency/Lean/DiophantineConsistency/CurrentWordRephase2011Checks.lean -o .lake/build/lib/lean/DiophantineConsistency/CurrentWordRephase2011Checks.olean
+```
+
+Both passed. Main took 3.79 seconds, peak RSS 3,341,148 KiB; checks took
+3.91 seconds, peak RSS 3,335,856 KiB. Main had no diagnostic. The checks have
+one benign exponentiation-threshold notice for the symbolic exponent 94517
+in the unequal-ordinary-multiplier control. All eight axiom reports contain
+only `propext`, `Classical.choice`, and `Quot.sound`. No `sorry`, added axiom,
+or `native_decide` occurs.
+
+Focused checks cover arbitrary numeric dummy controls at `N=1`, two full
+periods at `N=3`, exact packed-source equality, same-carry normalization at
+`N=1` without claiming a one-cell marked tiling, and preservation of a
+particular full packing. Negative controls prove unequal ordinary multipliers
+despite equal cyclic strides, and different binary rotations when strides
+are not congruent at `N=2`.
+
+The only development correction made the accepted `radix = 2^47` definition
+explicit when applying the generic rotation transport identity. No theorem
+statement or mathematical premise was changed. Frozen prior sources and git
+state were not edited.

+# Native packing population: independent Lean review
+
